v4-qsm.title: Quantitative susceptibility mapping
v4-qsm.input: Multi-echo magnitude and scanner-scaled phase images, brain and region masks, and acquisition geometry.
v4-qsm.output: Local-field and susceptibility maps, regional susceptibility relative to ventricular CSF, and a reusable pipeline.
v4-qsm.verification: Map and regional-value accuracy against simulated truth, including a rerun with a different subject and acquisition.

v4-t2epg.title: T2 and transmit-field mapping from imperfect echoes
v4-t2epg.input: A multi-echo spin-echo image series, region labels, and pulse timing with imperfect refocusing.
v4-t2epg.output: T2 and relative B1 maps on the input grid, regional mean T2 values, and a reusable fitting program.
v4-t2epg.verification: Map accuracy, low-B1 bias, regional values, and reproducible fits on public and unseen scans.

v5-dwigroup.title: Diffusion processing and a two-group comparison
v5-dwigroup.input: Scanner-exported diffusion images, gradient directions, acquisition times, region labels, and group assignments.
v5-dwigroup.output: Regional FA, MD and principal directions, group differences with confidence intervals, and a subject-processing program.
v5-dwigroup.verification: Tensor metrics and directions against truth, recomputed Welch statistics, and reruns on unseen subjects.

v5-irt1.title: Inversion-recovery T1 mapping with radial readouts
v5-irt1.input: A numerical object, prescribed inversion times, a radial sampling contract, and scanner hardware limits.
v5-irt1.output: An exported sequence, Bloch-simulated measurements, reconstructed images, a T1 map, and reusable reconstruction and fitting code.
v5-irt1.verification: Exported timing and trajectory, independent Bloch replay, T1 accuracy, and reconstruction and fitting on unseen inputs.

v5-learnrecon.title: Learned versus classical quantitative reconstruction
v5-learnrecon.input: Fully sampled training subjects and undersampled test scans, with echo times, masks, and tissue labels.
v5-learnrecon.output: A trained network, tuned classical baseline, both test reconstructions, and a comparison based on regional R2* and B0 accuracy.
v5-learnrecon.verification: Subject-level data separation, sampled k-space consistency, downstream accuracy, and both methods rerun on unseen subjects.

v5-safecpmg.title: CPMG design under RF and gradient limits
v5-safecpmg.input: Sample properties, echo-train requirements, and numerical RF, gradient, and peripheral-nerve-stimulation limits.
v5-safecpmg.output: An exported CPMG sequence, simulated echo trains, computed safety quantities, and a T2/B1 fitting program.
v5-safecpmg.verification: Limits recomputed from exported waveforms, independent Bloch replay, and T2/B1 accuracy on unseen noisy samples.

v5-spiralb0.title: Spiral imaging with off-resonance correction
v5-spiralb0.input: A numerical object with a spatial B0 field, a dual-echo field-mapping scan, and sequence constraints.
v5-spiralb0.output: An exported spiral sequence, simulated measurements, an estimated field map, and an off-resonance-corrected image.
v5-spiralb0.verification: Waveform limits and coverage, independent Bloch replay, field and image accuracy, and reconstruction on an unseen object.

v5-t2study.title: Scan-rescan T2 study from k-space to statistics
v5-t2study.input: Undersampled multi-coil scans, noise prescans, region labels, and an analysis plan for a study with one missing rescan.
v5-t2study.output: Per-scan T2 maps and measurements, participant-level group statistics, repeatability estimates, and reusable analysis code.
v5-t2study.verification: T2 accuracy, map-to-table consistency, prescribed statistics, and reruns on unseen scans and study tables.

v6-gapproposal.title: Evidence audit and research proposal
v6-gapproposal.input: A synthetic cardiac MRI study corpus and rules for evidence, research gaps, study design, and sample size.
v6-gapproposal.output: An evidence audit and cited proposal with a supported research gap, endpoint, controls, and enrolment calculation.
v6-gapproposal.verification: Claims and citations against the supplied corpus, gap and design rules, and sample-size arithmetic.

v6-honestresults.title: Trial reporting with traceable quantitative claims
v6-honestresults.input: Synthetic trial results, reporting rules, and an allowed bibliography.
v6-honestresults.output: An abstract, a Results section, and a claim ledger linking reported values and uncertainty to source entries.
v6-honestresults.verification: Endpoint coverage, units and precision, uncertainty, supported language, citation keys, and claim-to-text consistency.

v6-methodreview.title: Methods and statistics review of an MRI manuscript
v6-methodreview.input: A synthetic imaging manuscript with labelled paragraphs and tables, review categories, and pass criteria.
v6-methodreview.output: A structured review and referee report with quoted evidence, issue categories, proposed fixes, and a recommendation.
v6-methodreview.verification: Detected methodological problems, exact supporting quotations, and false accusations of sound passages.

v6-pilotdesign.title: Study design from pilot cartilage T2 measurements
v6-pilotdesign.input: Synthetic test-retest and patient-control pilot measurements, quality flags, and two proposed study questions.
v6-pilotdesign.output: Repeatability and group estimates, study designs, sample sizes, enrolment targets, and a short plan.
v6-pilotdesign.verification: Quality exclusions, participant-level analysis, uncertainty, design-specific variability, and sample-size calculations.

v7-cestapt.title: APT-weighted CEST mapping
v7-cestapt.input: CEST and WASSR image series, an unsaturated reference, frequency offsets, and saturation parameters.
v7-cestapt.output: A B0 map and an APT-weighted asymmetry map at 3.5 ppm, with a reusable processing program.
v7-cestapt.verification: Regional and voxelwise asymmetry and B0 accuracy on public and unseen acquisitions.

v7-dixonraw.title: Fat fraction and R2* from multi-coil k-space
v7-dixonraw.input: Raw multi-echo k-space, receiver noise, a transmit-field map, acquisition parameters, and the fat spectrum.
v7-dixonraw.output: Proton-density fat-fraction and R2* maps, a field-map figure, and a reusable reconstruction program.
v7-dixonraw.verification: Regional fat-fraction and R2* accuracy against truth, including reruns with different acquisition and coil settings.

v7-epidti.title: Diffusion tensor mapping from raw EPI
v7-epidti.input: Raw diffusion EPI and navigator readouts, a B0 map, gradient-nonlinearity fields, and a diffusion gradient table.
v7-epidti.output: FA, MD and principal-direction maps plus a corrected mean unweighted image on the undistorted grid.
v7-epidti.verification: Geometry, ghosting, regional tensor metrics and directions against truth, with reruns on unseen acquisitions.

v7-fmriglm.title: Event-related fMRI effect estimation
v7-fmriglm.input: A BOLD time series, event timings, slice and volume timing, and realignment parameters.
v7-fmriglm.output: Single-event percent-signal-change and positive-response z-statistic maps, with a reusable analysis program.
v7-fmriglm.verification: Effect-size accuracy and the null z distribution, including reruns with different timings and noise properties.

v7-mrsquant.title: Single-voxel metabolite quantification
v7-mrsquant.input: Raw multi-coil spectroscopy transients, a water reference, tissue fractions, and relaxation and acquisition parameters.
v7-mrsquant.output: NAA, total creatine and total choline concentrations, a spectrum-fit figure, and a reusable quantification program.
v7-mrsquant.verification: All three concentrations against truth on public and unseen data with different tissue and acquisition conditions.

v7-pcasl.title: Cerebral blood flow from pCASL
v7-pcasl.input: Alternating control and label images, an M0 reference, tissue T1 maps, and slice and labelling parameters.
v7-pcasl.output: A cerebral-blood-flow map in mL/100 g/min and a reusable quantification program.
v7-pcasl.verification: Grey- and white-matter flow by slice against truth, including reruns with changed timing and suppression settings.

v8-epinav.title: Gradient-echo EPI with delay-robust reconstruction
v8-epinav.input: A numerical object, EPI timing and sampling requirements, hardware limits, and a gradient-delay model.
v8-epinav.output: An exported sequence with any required reference echoes, simulated measurements, and an image-reconstruction program.
v8-epinav.verification: Timing and sampling, independent Bloch replay, and image accuracy on unseen objects with unknown gradient delays.

v8-mprage.title: 3D MP-RAGE with tissue nulling
v8-mprage.input: A numerical object, a target tissue T1, fixed readout and cycle constraints, and hardware limits.
v8-mprage.output: An exported MP-RAGE sequence with a justified inversion time, simulated measurements, and a reconstructed 3D image.
v8-mprage.verification: Waveforms and timing, steady-state tissue nulling, independent Bloch replay, and reconstruction on an unseen object.

v8-sedwi.title: Spin-echo EPI diffusion acquisition and ADC mapping
v8-sedwi.input: A numerical object, diffusion and spin-echo requirements, a diffusion model, and hardware limits.
v8-sedwi.output: An exported diffusion sequence, simulated measurements with b-matrices, an ADC map, and a reusable fitting program.
v8-sedwi.verification: Waveforms, spin-echo timing and b-matrices, independent simulation replay, and ADC accuracy on public and unseen objects.

v8-spiral.title: Interleaved spiral acquisition and reconstruction
v8-spiral.input: A numerical object, gradient and slew limits, sampling coverage requirements, and a recorded-delay model.
v8-spiral.output: An exported spiral sequence, simulated measurements, and a reconstruction program that handles the recorded gradient delay.
v8-spiral.verification: Integrated trajectories and coverage, independent Bloch replay, and image accuracy on unseen objects with gradient delays.

v8-tse.title: Multi-shot turbo spin-echo acquisition
v8-tse.input: A numerical object, prescribed refocusing angles and timing, echo-train requirements, and hardware limits.
v8-tse.output: An exported turbo spin-echo sequence, simulated echo trains, a reconstructed image, and reusable reconstruction code.
v8-tse.verification: Sampling and timing, echo phase and steady-state consistency, independent Bloch replay, and unseen-object reconstruction.

v8-ute.title: Ultrashort-echo imaging with half-pulse excitation
v8-ute.input: A numerical object containing short-T2 tissue, half-pulse pairing and radial coverage requirements, and hardware limits.
v8-ute.output: An exported UTE sequence, simulated paired measurements, a reconstructed slice image, and reusable reconstruction code.
v8-ute.verification: Echo time, pair slice profile and coverage, independent Bloch replay, short-T2 signal, and unseen-object reconstruction.
